name: kindle
desc: When Lina is rolled face up, each burning enemy gains 1 Burn stack.

name: corrosive
desc: When this character takes direct spell damage, apply 2 Poison to the damage source.

name: denial
desc: Immune to the first debuff status applied to this unit each battle.

name: dodging
desc: After Robin resolves a spell, gain Stealth.

name: steelheart
desc: After Bob resolves a spell, gain 2 shield.

name: dagger
desc: 3 uses. Face up: throw for 4 damage. When an ally gains Stealth, recover 1 use.

name: shield
desc: When thrown, give 2 shield to the front ally.

name: hand_crossbow
desc: Ammo 1. Face up or ally action: consume ammo to deal 4. Face up while empty: reload 1.

name: bow
desc: Face up: gain 1 charge. Reset after ally action or when losing face up.

name: sword_ready
desc: Face up: gain 1 Ready. Ready: while Sword is face up, after an ally spell resolves, deal 4 damage to the front enemy, then consume Ready.

name: magicbook
desc: When thrown, give 1 Speedup to the front ally.

name: hammer
desc: When thrown, apply 1 Lockout to self and the enemy face-up equipment. Lockout: throw and face-up effects are disabled, cannot stack, and is consumed after spell resolution.

name: broken stopwatch
desc: While face up, every 3 countdown ticks, give 1 Speedup to the front ally.

name: scorching echo
desc: After fireball resolves, deal 1 extra damage to each enemy character actually affected by it.

name: swift
desc: Cast this hex immediately when it is rolled face up. If countdown also reaches zero from the same roll, this hex only resolves once.

name: haunt echo
desc: After haunt resolves, deal 6 extra damage to each affected character if the caster has Stealth.

name: toxic spores
desc: When killed, poison the killer for 1 stack.

name: bright delight
desc: When damaged, gain Bright if absent and apply Speedup to all enemies. Otherwise remove Bright.

name: undefined
desc: When this enemy's countdown is reduced, gain Stealth if absent.

name: hidden maid
desc: After this enemy acts, gain Stealth if absent.

name: half wall retreat
desc: When this enemy first drops to half health or below, the player can leave the battle.

name: timed escape
desc: If it has never escaped before, start battle with 3 Escape. Lose 1 Escape after each action. Escape when Escape runs out, move to the nearest normal battle room, fully recover, gain max health, and learn an upgraded spell.

name: gilded echo
desc: After this enemy resolves a spell, apply Resonance to each character actually affected by that spell.

name: emberless recovery
desc: After this enemy acts, recover 4 health if it does not have Burn.

name: frontline urge
desc: After this enemy takes damage, advance 1.

name: impulsive
desc: When this enemy's countdown is reduced, advance 1.
